author: Xbox
description:
The rails are calling. Will you answer?

Grind through sky high tracks in city skylines, flip across oceans and drift across the railways of a dystopian Japan whilst chaining stylish combos in Denshattack! After the climate crisis ravaged the world and left humanity to survive in domes;  the Miraido megagorp dominated the land with their supersonic railway systems. However a movement is rising to reclaim the old forgotten rails!

Denshattack! is a high-adrenaline fuelled ride that sees you multi-drifting and kick-flipping your customisable train across 50+ levels of Japan's scenery whilst fighting enormous mechs and bosses AND clashing with rival gangs. Complete objectives, race rivals and perfect your combos! Do you have what it takes to be the next legendary Denshattacker!?

Backed by a hard hitting soundtrack from Tee Lopes (Sonic Mania, TMNT: Shredder’s Revenge) and more, this will be an experience beyond the visual!

Will you join the movement?

📅 Launching 17th of June 2026 on X
title: Denshattack! - Xbox Series Release Date Trailer
